column1: # Fixture upstream-parity sweep allowlist (Issue #10246 gate; drift backlog: Issue #10237)
# scripts/check_fixture_parity_sweep.sh runs every registered fixture of the
# selected categories under both sjulia and upstream julia
# not listed here. This is a TWO-SIDED RATCHET:
#   * a swept fixture that diverges and is NOT listed fails the gate
#     (no new drifted fixture can land silently);
#   * a listed fixture in a swept category that NO LONGER diverges fails as a
#     stale entry — remove its row (the list must monotonically shrink as the
# classification: sjulia-bug   = fixture asserts sjulia's wrong behavior (fix the VM, then the fixture)
#                 bad-fixture  = wrong / non-portable assertion (fix the fixture)
#                 untriaged    = red under upstream julia 1.12.6; not yet triaged into the above
# Initial population: the Issue #10237 backlog (13 fixtures found during the
# #9671 Phase 3 aggregation; types/types_supertype.jl has since been fixed and
# is NOT listed) plus 13 additional drifted fixtures found by the first sweep
